mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public or competent local authority in the country of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-registration screening of all incorporators, legal representatives, statutory auditors and ultimate beneficial owners against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU consolidated financial sanctions list, domestic Colombian sanctions and judicial records, Interpol notices, and the UIAF-supported PEP database. PEP status is not an automatic prohibition but requires enhanced due diligence, senior management approval, ongoing transaction monitoring, and reporting to the UIAF when suspicious activity is detected. Screening results and source documents must be retained for at least ten years under Colombian AML/CFT recordkeeping requirements.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RUES – Registro Único Empresarial y Social (https://www.rues.org.co); name search and 'Certificado de Homonimia' issued through the Cámara de Comercio of the S.A.S. domicile
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be written in Spanish or in a transliteration that is intelligible in Colombian commercial usage; names must not mislead as to the nature, scope or public character of the entity; every S.A.S. must include the designation 'S.A.S.' The name must be unique in the RUES national database and must respect protected trademarks and prior commercial names.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Cámara de Comercio rejects the proposed name or issues a negative homonimia result, the applicant may file a grounded reconsideration appeal (recurso de reposición) before the same Chamber within ten business days and, jointly or in the alternative, a hierarchical appeal (recurso de apelación) before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio. A name clearance certificate cannot be extended; if the 30-day window expires, a new homonimia certificate must be obtained. If the administrative appeal fails, judicial review may be sought under the 'nulidad y restablecimiento del derecho' action before the Consejo de Estado. The rejected name may not be registered while an appeal is pending.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office may be accepted by a Cámara de Comercio as a corporate domicile only for non-regulated administrative activities. It is not permissible as the sole registered office for ISIC 5210 refrigerated cold storage operations, because the licensed cold-chain activity requires a physical controlled-temperature warehouse, municipal zoning and health permits, INVIMA inspection access, and demonstrable commercial substance at the point of operation.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High. Estimated 75% probability of an unannounced INVIMA inspection within the first 12 months of operation for a licensed refrigerated pharmaceutical warehouse, and approximately 40% probability of a combined municipal health, DIAN or labor inspection within the first six months. The sector is classified as requiring statutory license and carries a regulatory inspection regime.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law 1258 of 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada) Arts. 5, 9 and 17, in concordance with the Commercial Code (Decree 410 of 1971) Arts. 110-119 (Mercantile Registry) and Decree 1074 of 2015.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio with territorial jurisdiction over the registered office, processing through the Registro Único Empresarial (RUES); supervised by the Superintendencia de Sociedades.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (Private Incorporation Document) registered in the Registro Mercantil / Registro Único Empresarial (RUE).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Law 1258 of 2008, Arts. 5 and 9: no legal minimum; subscribed capital may be paid at incorporation as to zero paid-up, but any subscribed amount must be fully paid within 24 months. No statutory escrow is required; funds may be held in a corporate bank account. Foreign-currency contributions must be exchanged through a local authorized intermediary and registered with Banco de la República.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION NO. 001 OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [COMPANY] S.A.S. — On this day of [month, year], the Board unanimously resolves at the registered office: FIRST: to ratify the subscription of the authorized share capital as stated in Article Fourth of the incorporation document; SECOND: to adopt the registered office at [full address], municipality of [city], as the statutory domicile; THIRD: to appoint [Name] as Legal Representative, [Name] as Secretary, and [Name] as Cold Storage Operations Manager; FOURTH: to authorize the Legal Representative to obtain the RUT, complete mercantile registration at the Chamber of Commerce, and open the corporate bank account; FIFTH: to confirm compliance with Law 1258 of 2008 and the bylaws. Approved unanimously.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Availability Search and Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio with jurisdiction over the registered office; online portal: Registro Único Empresarial (RUES).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name search request in the RUES portal or at the Chamber window with up to five proposed names. The Chamber issues a homonimia certificate confirming the selected name does not conflict with an existing company or trademark. The reserved name remains valid for 60 calendar days.
required_dossiers: Completed RUES name search application
List of proposed corporate names (up to five)
Identity document of the applicant shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a proposed name is rejected for conflict, present an alternative name on the same application; if refusal is disputed, file a written request to the Chamber pursuant to Commercial Code Art. 33 for administrative review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Authentication of the Private Incorporation Document
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría (Notary Public) competent in the municipality of the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Documento Privado de Constitución under Law 1258 of 2008 containing the full S.A.S. bylaws, capital table, and share subscriptions. Shareholders execute the instrument; signatures must be acknowledged (autenticación de firmas) before a Notary. If real property is contributed, the document must be elevated to a public deed (escritura pública).
required_dossiers: Private incorporation document (S.A.S. bylaws)
Valid national ID (cédula) or passport of each subscribing shareholder
Name availability certificate (homonimia)
Notarial power of attorney, apostilled, if signed by an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Notary identifies omissions (e.g., incomplete capital table or missing shareholder data), amend the document by a corrective annex and schedule a new notarial appointment; correction is typically completed within 1-3 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — online portal (RUT service) or local DIAN office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the Pre-RUT form selecting the ordinary responsible regime and the economic activity code ISIC 5210 (warehousing and storage). The DIAN issues a provisional NIT that is finalized after the Chamber registers the company. The Pre-RUT is indispensable to obtain the final RUT and to open a corporate bank account.
required_dossiers: Pre-RUT application form
Copy of the signed incorporation document
Identity document of the legal representative
Registered office address description (location certificate if available)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DIAN queries the application for activity-code or address errors, correct the CIIU classification and resubmit electronically; field agents can update the Pre-RUT at the DIAN office without imposing a penalty within the same tax period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Mercantile Registration at the Chamber of Commerce (Registro Mercantil)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio with territorial jurisdiction over the registered office — RUES window or virtual office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the authenticated incorporation document, the Pre-RUT, and the official registration form with the Chamber. Pay the registry tariff calculated on the subscribed capital (standard S.A.S. base fee included in the estimated USD 95 total). Upon approval, the Chamber issues the Matrícula Mercantil and the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal and transmits incorporation data to DIAN for final RUT/NIT issuance.
required_dossiers: Authenticated private incorporation document
Pre-RUT certificate from DIAN
Name availability certificate (homonimia)
Official Chamber registration form
Identity document of the legal representative
Proof of fee payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is returned with observations, cure the deficiencies within 10 business days through the RUES portal; failing to do so may archive the process. Unjustified refusal can be appealed before the Superintendencia de Sociedades.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investment Registration with Banco de la República (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Banco de la República through an authorized local commercial bank (intermediary of the foreign exchange market).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 90 days of the capital remittance, submit Form No. 5 (Declaración de Cambio por Inversión Internacional) through the local bank. This registration secures the foreign shareholder's right to repatriate capital and remit dividends. The declarant must present the company's identification, the capital receipt, and the incorporation certificates.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal of the company
Final RUT/NIT certificate
SWIFT or bank proof of the foreign capital transfer
Board resolution authorizing the foreign investment
Identification and constitutive documents of the foreign investor
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the declaration for missing annexes, obtain certified copies of the Chamber certificate and DIAN RUT and resubmit; late registration is accepted by Banco de la República with an acknowledgment of the delay, without loss of investment rights.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Bank Account Opening and Capitalization
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank supervised by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate checking or savings account in the company's name using the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal (issued within the last 90 days) and the final RUT. Deposit subscribed paid-in capital and issue the deposit certificate required for future licensing and contracting. The bank will screen the beneficial owners and execute the client due diligence file.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal (less than 90 days old)
Final RUT and NIT certificate
Board resolution appointing account signatories
Identity documents of shareholders and signatories
Beneficial owner declaration form
Warehouse address verification for KYC purposes
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests enhanced due diligence, provide the ultimate beneficial ownership chart and source-of-funds statement; if the opening is delayed beyond five business days, escalate to the branch compliance officer or file a claim with the Defensor del Consumidor Financiero.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos (INVIMA) for pharmaceutical storage certification; municipal Curaduría Urbana for land use and construction clearances.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Certificado de Buenas Prácticas de Almacenamiento (BPA) de Medicamentos (Pharmaceutical Good Storage Practices Certificate) and Certificado de Uso de Suelo (Land Use and Commercial Operation Permit).

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible through the Regional Autonomous Corporation (Corporación Autónoma Regional - CAR) having jurisdiction over the facility location.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category II — Moderate Impact: environmental registration (Registro de Plan de Manejo Ambiental) rather than a full EIA; a full EIA may be triggered only for ammonia refrigeration systems above 30 tons, standby generators above a threshold set by the CAR, or location inside a protected ecosystem.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Non-domestic wastewater: pH 6.0-9.0, BOD5 <= 80 mg/L, TSS <= 80 mg/L under Resolution 0631 of 2015; refrigerant handling under the ozone-depleting substances regime of Resolution 1777 of 2017; hazardous waste (spent refrigerants, oils, glycol) must be declared and disposed under Decree 4741 of 2005 via the RESPEL reporting platform.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Certificado de Seguridad Humana y Protección Contra Incendios issued by the Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos verifying fire suppression systems, emergency exits and alarms; structural load certificate (memoria de cálculo estructural) approved by the Curaduría Urbana confirming floor and racking loads; occupational safety and health workplace clearance filed with the Ministerio del Trabajo and ARL coverage for employees.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN); official portal: www.dian.gov.co; taxpayer e-services portal: muisca.dian.gov.co
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign-owned Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (S.A.S.): (1) appoint a local legal representative; (2) obtain the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) before DIAN, either electronically or at a DIAN service center; (3) the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) is automatically assigned upon RUT issuance; (4) update the RUT to reflect 'Responsable de IVA' status for VAT purposes; (5) activate mandatory electronic invoicing authorisation before commencing taxable operations; (6) if engaging in international trade, register the NIT as customs code with DIAN and obtain a digital signature.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election exists. An S.A.S. is a separate taxpayer subject to Colombian corporate income tax and VAT. A qualifying small enterprise may elect the Régimen Simple de Tributación (RS) under Articles 905–930 of the Colombian Tax Code if gross turnover does not exceed 80,000 UVT per year; this election replaces standard corporate income tax and certain local taxes, but VAT obligations remain applicable where required. Hybrid mismatch rules under Law 2010 of 2019 apply automatically and do not require a taxpayer election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA (Impuesto sobre las Ventas) — Colombian value-added tax
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: None for S.A.S. legal entities: VAT registration is mandatory from the first taxable activity, regardless of turnover. The simplified-taxpayer threshold of 3,500 UVT per year applies only to natural persons and is not available to S.A.S.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time electronic invoicing under Decree 2242 of 2015 and DIAN Resolution 000165 of 2022. Invoices must be generated by DIAN-authorised software or through certified e-invoicing service providers, transmitted electronically to DIAN for validation before issue, and include the CUFE (Código Único de Facturación) and a QR code. Credit/debit notes and 'Nota de Ajuste' documents must also be transmitted electronically. Taxpayers must submit exógena information returns and may be subject to operational audits through DIAN's e-invoicing transaction-monitoring system.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods: a sale qualifies for the 0% IVA rate when the goods are physically exported from Colombian customs territory under a valid export declaration and the seller is a registered VAT taxpayer. Services: a service may qualify as zero-rated if it qualifies as an 'exported service' (servicio exportado) — rendered to a non-resident recipient, not connected to any local establishment, and used exclusively abroad. Cold-storage warehousing physically performed in Colombia is generally taxable unless DIAN interprets the service as forming part of an integrated export logistics chain supplied to a foreign principal with economic benefit abroad; the taxpayer must prove foreign receipt and benefit.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación – DEX / SAD)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill (BL / AWB)
Inward Remittance Certificate / Comprobante de Liquidación de Divisas issued by an authorised Colombian foreign-exchange intermediary
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN may reassess zero-rated exports if the documentation is incomplete or if the foreign-exchange repatriation deadline is missed. Consequences include: disallowance of the 0% rate and imposition of 19% VAT with interest, an inaccuracy penalty equal to 160% of the omitted VAT for fraudulent or inaccurate returns, customs-fraud penalties (including goods seizure or fines), and retroactive clawback within the ordinary five-year statute of limitations. Criminal liability may attach for false customs declarations and fraudulent export-documentation schemes.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Central Bank of Colombia), acting jointly with the Ministerio de Hacienda y Crédito Público; day-to-day administration and enforcement are exercised through the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) and the authorized foreign-exchange intermediaries (IMCs) under Decree 1068 of 2015 and Resolución Externa No. 1 of 2018 (Régimen Cambiario), as amended.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso (COP) operates under a managed float with the representative market rate (TRM) published by the Banco de la República. COP is fully convertible for current-account transactions and for foreign direct investment (capital account) inflows and outflows, but every foreign-exchange transaction must be channelled through the Mercado Cambiario using an authorized IMC and recorded via an electronic Declaración de Cambio. Profit remittances (dividends) and capital repatriation are freely permissible once the foreign investment is registered with the Banco de la República and applicable Colombian taxes have been settled. There is no pre-approval license for the initial equity remittance, but the remitter must match the registered investor; mischaracterized or unregistered transfers risk being classified as illegal exchange operations under Law 9 of 1991.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For the warehousing and refrigerated logistics services (ISIC 5210) billed to non-residents, 100% of the foreign-currency proceeds must be channelled through an IMC and reported on Declaración de Cambio Form No. 3 at the moment of collection; the proceeds must be received within 3 months following the service performance or billing event, subject to limited extensions granted by the Banco de la República. For any ancillary goods exports, Form No. 1 applies, requiring 100% reintegro within 3 months of the export declaration. There is no mandatory conversion into COP; the exporter may retain foreign currency in a foreign-currency account at the IMC, whereas amounts held abroad are permitted only through a pre-authorized cuenta de compensación.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Current Account (Cuenta Corriente) with COP/USD FX settlement sub-account
Operational Current Account with Capital Escrow sub-account for foreign-investment registration

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: BBVA Colombia (Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria Colombia S.A.)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account; preferred corridor for non-resident Latin American wiring
Capital Escrow Account (cuenta de depósito en garantía) for shareholder loans and equity contributions
Cross-border clearing account for USD flows and trade settlements

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW (0.2/1.0) as the primary treasury rail; MEDIUM (0.5/1.0) as an auxiliary collection or payout rail outside Colombia. Legal constraints: (i) SEDPES-type fintechs (Nequi, Daviplata, Movii, Powwi, Dale) operate only in COP and are not authorized IMCs; (ii) offshore EMIs (Wise, Airwallex, Payoneer, Revolut Business) lack an SFC banking or money-exchange license and cannot intermediate Colombian FX operations without acting through a local IMC; any other structure violates Law 9 of 1991 and Resolución Externa 1 of 2018; (iii) funds held by an unlicensed EMI are not protected by FOGAFÍN deposit insurance and would trigger enhanced UIAF reporting and KYC friction. The blueprint permits EMI rails only for non-Colombian disbursement legs after conversion through the primary IMC.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory: the legal representative (a natural person with a Colombian cédula or a valid foreign passport) must attend a face-to-face interview at the bank branch and sign account contracts; remote opening is not currently permitted for corporate clients in standard practice, as pandemic-era relaxations have expired. Non-resident shareholders and directors may execute a notarized and apostilled power of attorney (poder especial) granting a resident attorney-in-fact full signature authority, but every ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) holding 25% or more must be individually identified with certified identity documents. The bank will conduct an on-site visit of the temperature-controlled facility and verify the INVIMA storage license, lease title, and utility records before account activation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore corporate chain: the 100% parent is a non-resident holding company in a low-tax jurisdiction, creating opacity about ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) and the source of funds.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (i) Apostilled certificate of incorporation, good standing, and constitutional documents of each entity in the chain; (ii) certified shareholder registry and a UBO declaration (natural persons above 25%) signed under liability of perjury; (iii) bank reference letters from the parent's principal bank covering the prior 12 months; (iv) source-of-funds file comprising audited financial statements, board minutes approving the contribution, and acquisition receipts; (v) independent Colombian legal opinion confirming beneficial ownership and non-PEP status; (vi) matched remitter: the wired amount must come exclusively from the registered shareholder's bank account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Refrigerated pharmaceutical logistics is adjacent to the regulated medicines supply chain, raising diversion, counterfeit-product, and import/export declaration mismatch risks.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (i) INVIMA sanitary operating license and Good Storage Practices (BPM) certificate for the facility; (ii) executed storage service agreements with licensed pharmaceutical manufacturers and distributors, including valid NITs and sanitary registrations; (iii) certified floor plan, lease agreement, and cold-chain insurance policies; (iv) DIAN electronic invoicing (factura electrónica) and supporting logistics documentation; (v) a written SARLAFT/AML compliance manual with a designated compliance officer; (vi) continuous temperature-monitoring records demonstrating a bona fide physical operation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The initial capital injection is routed via a third-party paying agent or a fintech account, creating the risk of non-channelled foreign-exchange proceeds and automatic UIAF escalation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (i) Pre-approval by the designated IMC of the incoming SWIFT MT103/MT202 with investor name, beneficiary account, and NIT matched; (ii) foreign-exchange declaration Form No. 4 (inversión internacional) and the foreign-investment registration certificate issued by the Banco de la República; (iii) capitalisation minutes of the S.A.S. and issuance of shares or quota documentation; (iv) proof of the remitter's corporate authority via board resolution; (v) for shareholder loans, a signed loan agreement, market-rate interest calculation, and Form No. 4 classification as financiación externa; (vi) updated DIAN and RUT certificates confirming tax registration.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Protocol: (1) execute the S.A.S. capitalisation minutes and, if applicable, a shareholder loan agreement; (2) receive the inbound wire exclusively at the designated IMC account, instructing the parent to send a SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's own account with the concept 'Aporte de capital - Inversión Extranjera Directa' and the S.A.S. NIT as beneficiary reference; (3) within five business days of receipt, file the foreign-exchange declaration Form No. 4 with the IMC using purpose code 'Aporte de capital a sociedades nacionales'; (4) obtain the IMC certificate of foreign investment and register the investment with the Banco de la República's Registro de Inversiones Internacionales before any subsequent dividend distribution or capital repatriation; (5) maintain USD in a foreign-currency account at the IMC or convert at the TRM. The GMF (0.4%) applies only to debits, so the inflow itself is clearing-cost-free; remitter-name consistency and purpose-code discipline are mandatory, as any mismatch triggers return, freeze, and automatic UIAF disclosure.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails: (i) SWIFT MT103 through the IMC for operational imports, insurance, and professional services, attaching the commercial invoice and, where applicable, the import declaration and DIAN Forms with purpose code 'pago de servicios - almacenamiento refrigerado' (Form No. 3) or 'importación de bienes' (Form No. 2); (ii) commercial Letters of Credit (UCP 600) and documentary collections for capital equipment such as cold rooms and HVAC-R units, opened against the S.A.S. credit facility with 10-30% margin requirements; (iii) domestic CENIT ACH (ACH Colombia) and CUD instant-payment channels for payroll and local supplier disbursements; (iv) consolidate account debits to limit GMF (0.4%) and use exempt categories (tax payments, payroll, and trade-related external-credit transactions) provided by the IMC; all outbound COP/USD conversions must be settled in the Mercado Cambiario with documented underlying trade exposure.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: OTC deliverable COP/USD forward contracts (Forwards de Tasa de Cambio) executed through an authorized IMC for real-economy exposure
Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) on COP/USD settled against the TRM with a local bank counterparty
Cross-currency swaps (CCS/CCIRS) for long-term USD shareholder loans or equipment liabilities
FX swaps (Cambio de Monedas, spot-next) for short-term USD/COP liquidity management

Vanilla currency options and collars listed through an IMC, permitted only when the hedge is supported by demonstrable commercial exposure and does not constitute speculative position-taking prohibited by Resolución Externa 1 of 2018

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil (Annual Mercantile Registry Renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio with territorial jurisdiction over the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 31 March; the official chamber tariff is asset-based and typically falls within USD 100–250 for this cold-storage S.A.S.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers a graduated monetary penalty and additional chamber charges; failure to renew for two consecutive years can result in cancellation of the commercial registration and loss of access to business records and transactional capacity.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Filing of Annual Financial Statements (Estados Financieros de Fin de Ejercicio)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio; copy retained for inspection by Superintendencia de Sociedades
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within the first three months of the fiscal year (by 31 March) for the preceding calendar year; no additional government fee when filed electronically with the mercantile renewal.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: The chamber will block renewal of the mercantile registration until prior-year financial statements are submitted; continued omission may be referred to the Superintendencia de Sociedades for administrative fines and to DIAN for tax-related sanctions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Owner Confirmation (Informe de Beneficiario Final)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually in the staggered calendar window designated by DIAN Resolution 164/2023; the exact due date is based on the last digit of the company's NIT and generally falls within the first semester. The report confirms UBOs as of 31 December.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit or incorrect submission is subject to monetary fines under Law 2120/2021, repeated violations can escalate fines, and non-compliance may restrict the company's tax clearance and public procurement eligibility.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory appointment of a Revisor Fiscal (statutory auditor) is required for a Colombian S.A.S. when (i) total assets exceed 5,000 SMMLV (approx. USD 1.6 million), (ii) gross revenue exceeds 3,000 SMMLV (approx. USD 1.0 million), (iii) the entity has more than 200 employees, or (iv) the entity is part of a business group or qualifies as a large taxpayer under DIAN rules.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Full IFRS (NIIF plenas) applies to Group 1 large entities; a cold-storage S.A.S. not falling into Group 1 must apply IFRS for SMEs (NIIF para las PYMES) under Decree 3022 of 2013. Financial statements are prepared in COP and must be deposited with the Cámara de Comercio.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: A natural person who directly or indirectly holds at least 10% of the shares, voting rights, or control of the S.A.S. is a final beneficiary. Any share transfer must be recorded immediately in the Libro de Registro de Accionistas. The company must file an annual DIAN Beneficiario Final report confirming current UBOs as of 31 December; any transfer crossing the 10% threshold during the year must be reported as an update within 10 business days of completion. The register of shareholders must identify the beneficial owner behind nominee or intermediary holdings.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000 – 6,000 for a mid-size cold-storage S.A.S.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% flat corporate income tax (Art. 240 E.T., as amended by Law 2277 of 2022); no progressive brackets for legal entities.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general tax holiday is available to a cold-storage/logistics SAS. Preferential instruments: (i) 25% income-tax credit (descuento tributario) for qualifying investments in science, technology and innovation (Art. 256 E.T.); (ii) deduction for environmental-control investments up to 20% of net taxable income (Art. 158-2 E.T.); (iii) reduced 20% rate for certified Free Zone users, not automatic and requires prior DIAN zoning approval; (iv) presumptive income (renta presuntiva) is suspended at 0% for tax years 2023-2026, but must be monitored for reactivation.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited (indefinite) carryforward, but annual offset is capped at 5% of ordinary taxable income (Art. 147 E.T.); losses do not expire but are absorbed slowly for larger bases.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 110 – Declaración de Renta y Complementarios (Personas Jurídicas y Asimiladas), filed electronically through the DIAN MUISCA portal (www.dian.gov.co) using the taxpayer's NIT-based virtual account and authorized digital certificate (firma electrónica).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual. The SAS must use the calendar tax year (January 1 - December 31); fiscal-year election is not permitted.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within the calendar year following the tax period, between early August and mid-September, under the annual DIAN deadline schedule keyed to the last two digits of the NIT (approximately 8 months after the December 31 year-end). For tax year 2024 the window spanned August 11 - September 9, 2025.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross revenue accrued from temperature-controlled storage, handling, cold-chain logistics and ancillary warehousing services, including Colombian-source export services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all worldwide accrued revenues of the Colombian SAS; this return covers the entity itself, not the foreign shareholder.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Sales returns, rebates and trade discounts granted to clients in the normal course of warehousing operations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only Colombian-recorded commercial adjustments; any cross-currency adjustments must be evidenced and valued at the exchange rate per DIAN rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 13 - Ingresos no constitutivos de renta ni ganancia ocasional
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-taxable income, including dividends received from profits already taxed at the corporate level, recovery of certain provisions and government grants explicitly exempted by law.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders do not enter their own dividend income on this return; the SAS reports only non-taxable income accrued by the entity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 24 - Costos de venta / prestación de servicios
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct costs of providing cold-storage services: energy for refrigeration, consumables, direct labor, handling equipment depreciation, and freight in.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Costs paid to foreign related parties must be supported by transfer-pricing documentation; unsupported invoices are nondeductible.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 35 - Deducciones (nómina, arrendamientos, servicios públicos, depreciación, seguros)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating deductions: salaries and social contributions, rent of facilities, utilities, maintenance, insurance, depreciation of cooling assets, and amortization of intangibles.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payments to foreign service providers require WHT at source and documentary proof; otherwise DIAN disallows the deduction and applies the 160% inaccuracy penalty.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exempt rents, applicable only where the SAS operates from an approved Free Zone or receives specifically legislated exemptions; ordinary cold storage does not qualify.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the entity is not a certified Free Zone user, leave zero; claiming an unjustified exemption triggers full reassessment and penalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax-loss carryforward applied, limited to 5% of the ordinary net income before the loss offset (Art. 147 E.T.).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses from foreign activities are not attributable unless properly integrated into the Colombian tax base through controlled-foreign-corporation rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final taxable base after exemptions, deductions and loss offsets.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A zero or negative base must be reconciled by the tax advisor; the DIAN may audit the calculation and compare against the financial statements.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: CIT at 35% applied to the renta líquida gravable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No branch-level or remittance tax applies to the SAS; the 35% is the sole entity-level income tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax credits: 25% CTeI credit, foreign tax credits, and other legislated credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign taxes paid by the foreign parent are not creditable on the SAS return; only taxes actually borne by the SAS are creditable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 66 - Retenciones en la fuente y anticipos
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Creditable withholdings and prepayments, including the 2% RETEICA withheld by clients on the SAS's invoices and the 100% advance payment (anticipo) made in the prior year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: WHT certificates issued by third parties must be kept in the entity's tax file for 5 years.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 70/71 - Total impuesto a cargo / saldo a favor
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net tax payable after credits and advance payments, or refundable balance.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any refund claimed must be reconciled with the exógena information and the external audit reports; refunds may be cross-checked with the foreign shareholder's capital contributions.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing (Art. 641 E.T.): 5% of the tax due plus 1% per month of delay, capped at 100% of the tax due and subject to a minimum of 10 UVT (≈ COP 470,650 in 2024). Inaccurate or fraudulent return (Art. 647 E.T.): 160% of the omitted tax. Failure to file digitally or in the required format triggers additional sanctions under Art. 651 E.T.; moratory interest accrues monthly until payment.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final withholding on dividends paid from profits that have already borne the 35% CIT; 35% withholding on distributions sourced from untaxed or exempt profits (with a further 10-percentage-point surcharge applicable in specific high-tier distributions); Colombian-resident corporate shareholders are exempt from WHT on dividends from taxed profits.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The Colombian SAS, as withholding agent, may apply the DTA-reduced rate only after receiving: (i) the Tax Residency Certificate (TRC / Certificado de Residencia Fiscal) issued by the foreign tax authority for the relevant calendar year; (ii) a signed beneficial-ownership declaration; and (iii) evidence of the minimum holding period if the treaty requires a qualified shareholding. If the domestic 10% was withheld at source, the non-resident may recover the excess through a DIAN refund request within the statutory prescriptive window (generally 2 years from the filing deadline). The WHT is declared and paid monthly on Form 350; no prior DIAN approval is required where documentation is complete.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic statutory rates: interest - 15% when paid to qualified foreign financial institutions and 20% for other foreign lenders; royalties and licence fees - 20%; technical-assistance fees - 15% where genuinely structured as services (recharacterization risk if disguised royalties). Under Colombia's active DTA network (Spain, UK, Mexico, Chile, South Korea, Switzerland, Portugal, Canada and others), treaty ceilings typically range from 5% to 15% for interest and royalties; the applicable rate must be confirmed against the specific treaty and the TRC.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File and Master File (annual Form 220 transfer-pricing report) when the taxpayer's gross equity or gross income in the preceding tax year exceeded COP 100,000 million (≈ USD 25 million). Transactions with related parties in tax havens or preferential regimes must be documented regardless of the threshold. The Country-by-Country report is due where the multinational group's consolidated revenue exceeded COP 1,200,000 million (≈ USD 300 million). Documentation must be prepared in Spanish and delivered to DIAN within audit deadlines (typically 10-20 business days upon request).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Colombia does not apply Caribbean-style ESR statutes, but DIAN applies the general anti-abuse rule (Art. 869 E.T.) and the substance-over-form doctrine. A cold-storage SAS lacking real premises, operational personnel, incumbent risk management, and a genuine commercial purpose may be disregarded as a shell, with profits reattributed to the actual economic owner and the corporate veil lifted. Anti-shelter scrutiny is heightened for entities transacting with foreign related parties in low-tax jurisdictions, and the 2022 CFC rules further tax passive income of controlled entities abroad.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Omitting cold-storage receipts, invoicing phantom operating costs (fictitious energy, labor or maintenance charges), or inflating related-party management fees to strip Colombian taxable income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN inaccuracy penalty of 160% of the omitted tax (Art. 647 E.T.) plus moratory interest; criminal evasion under Art. 434A of the Colombian Criminal Code carries imprisonment of 36 to 108 months and fines quantified in UVT; the tax authority may also order the confiscation of assets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Administrators and de facto managers who authorized the fraudulent return are jointly liable under Art. 793 E.T. for the unremitted tax, face criminal prosecution as co-authors, and may be subject to precautionary travel bans and disqualification from managing commercial companies.
